verification_steps: Claim a scratch knot with kno claim --e2e <id> --lease <id>, write a note under that lease, read it back with kno show -v: the author is the persona slug.
Repeat for a handoff capsule written with kno update -H under the same bound lease.

A note written with NO bound lease still reads as unattributed, AND a note written under a bound lease is DISTINGUISHABLE from it: write one of each, read both back with kno show -v, and confirm they do not render identically. If some write path's author genuinely cannot be resolved, that path must render differently from a documented leaseless write rather than sharing its label.
